title: Combined finite denominator / repair freeze baseline
root_cause: Repair and cohesion work lacked one finite, hash-bound source/control denominator.
source_requirement: Freeze product defects, assurance defects, reconciliation, installed proof, architecture, migrations, tests, and exclusions before source edits.
implementation_steps: Enumerate 43 required cards and explicit exclusions.
Bind exact evidence bytes with SHA-256.
negative_cases: Do not begin source changes before the denominator exists.
Do not allow deferred enhancements to grow the campaign.
focused_tests: JSON parse, count reconciliation, and SHA256SUMS verification.
evidence_required: Source head, product/harness digests, all card IDs, proof obligations, exclusions, and repair rules.
rollback: Supersede with a new explicitly hash-bound denominator; never edit old evidence in place after implementation begins.
acceptance_criteria: The denominator is finite, parseable, and hash-bound.
The required card count is exactly 43.
